{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|the dance|the language commonly known as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]}}
'''Basic''' dancing was a simple style of dancing performed by [[entertainer]]s and unskilled performers. Professional dancers could enhance the style of dancing by including miming motions, and popping moves in which which the dancer moved backwards while seemingly walking forwards.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's this Seinfeld episode that showed Elaine dancing. She was just awful. So that's where this one got its name.|Damon Lane Waldrip explaining their inspiration for one of the flourishes of the Basic dance|<ref name="MoCap">{{SonyCite|url=team/articles/2mocap_1.jsp|text=Mo-Cap: Part 2: The Dance}}</ref>}}
[[W:c:swg:Basic (Dance)|Basic]] dancing was included as a dance style in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Two types of the dance (Basic and Basic2) were available as dance abilities for players of the [[W:c:swg:Entertainer (pre-NGE)|entertainer]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]].<ref name="AED" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], the first of the two Basic dance abilities was made available to all players, but only the newly revamped [[W:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]] could perform the slightly more complicated Basic2 dance, or any of the eight associated "[[W:c:swg:Flourish (Ability)|flourishes]]," special dance moves that added variety to the dance routine.<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Motion-capture performer [[Sabrina Fox]] provided many of the dance moves and flourishes for [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']], including those associated with the Basic dance style.<ref name="MoCap" /> Although not specifically named in the game,<ref name="AED" /> a couple of the flourishes for the Basic dance style included the [[Wikipedia:Moonwalk (dance)|moonwalk]] and a dance move nicknamed "The Elaine." [[Damon Waldrip|Damon Lane Waldrip]], Senior Artist for ''Star Wars Galaxies'', explained that the inspiration behind "The Elaine" dance flourish was an episode of [[W:c:seinfeld:Seinfeld|''Seinfeld'']] named "[[W:c:seinfeld:The Little Kicks|The Little Kicks]]," in which the character [[W:c:seinfeld:Elaine Benes|Elaine Benes]] dances terribly.<ref name="MoCap" /> Indeed, the game's files include the animation file titled "all_b_dnc_goofy_sp_elaine.ans."<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref>
